citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'})
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
MATCH (ch2:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA'})
WHERE ch2.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch2.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AND ch2.peak_hc = peak_hc
RETURN peak_hc AS peak_head_count, collect(ch2.hour_utc) AS peak_hours
